licenses.rationale: Accepted for the reviewed PyPI scope: binsreg is a separately installed optional DPI backend and no backend files are bundled in binspect distributions. Retain binspect's MIT license; any redistribution of binsreg or a combined environment must preserve applicable GPL license/source obligations and requires renewed review.

Accepted for the reviewed PyPI scope: certifi is separately installed through docs/build/audit tooling and its covered files are not bundled in binspect distributions. Any redistribution of the certificate bundle, environment, cache or image must retain applicable MPL notice/source availability and requires renewed review.

Accepted for the reviewed PyPI scope: Docutils is separately installed through Twine/readme-renderer and no Docutils files are bundled in binspect distributions. The GPL Emacs helper is sdist-only in the inspected pair; redistributing Docutils artifacts or tooling environments must retain file-specific notices and obligations and requires renewed review.

Accepted for the reviewed PyPI scope: fqdn is separately installed only for audit schema validation and is not bundled in binspect distributions. Prefer the inspected wheel when retaining tooling; redistribution, especially of the notice-incomplete sdist, requires renewed source/notice review.

Accepted for the reviewed PyPI scope: Hypothesis is a separately installed development-test dependency and no Hypothesis files or test environment are bundled in binspect distributions. Any redistributed test environment must retain applicable MPL and file-specific third-party notices and requires renewed artifact review.

Accepted for the reviewed PyPI scope: pathspec is separately installed through build/dev/docs tooling and is not bundled in binspect distributions. Any redistribution of its covered files or a tooling environment must retain applicable MPL notice/source availability and requires renewed review.
